confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Austin food and drink prices. The food and drink results were mostly individual menu snapshots, not a price index. Cappuccino and beer are reasonably supported by those snapshots. The inexpensive meal and mid-range meal figures are estimates from general knowledge, and I found no aggregated source for them. Cocktail and wine are based on the usual US relationship to beer, plus the $10 to $17 cocktail range seen in the search. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates, not checked against any listings. They are uncertain because Austin hotel prices swing with events such as SXSW and F1. The RBA search result showed 0.6677 for 19 November 2026, but it also noted that this figure might be provisional. The overview page confirmed 0.6720 for 18 November, so I used that confirmed 18 November figure.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other US mid-to-high-cost tourist cities such as Denver and Nashville, and slightly cheaper than San Francisco or Boston.
